title: Point-of-Care CRISPR Diagnostic with Paper Microfluidics
abstract: A low-cost diagnostic combining CRISPR-Cas12a with paper microfluidics detecting pathogen nucleic acids at 10 copies/uL in 30 minutes.
claims: Paper microfluidic device with zones for lysis, extraction, RPA, CRISPR detection.
Cas12a-crRNA targeting conserved sequences with FAM-ssDNA-BHQ1 reporter.
Smartphone-readable colorimetric lateral flow with 10 copies/uL detection limit.
problem_statement: PCR requires $50K equipment. Paper-based CRISPR could enable $1 tests.
